claims: C1: When interacting with third parties on behalf of the user, the assistant must not lie by commission unless the user explicitly instructed it to do so.
C2: Lies of omission on behalf of the user may be acceptable when they align with general social norms and expectations.
C3: The assistant is expected to be honest and forthright, clarifying uncertainty whenever needed and avoiding deceptive behavior.

concepts.name: third_party_interaction
concepts.gloss: A is an interaction with a third party on behalf of the user, such as a tool call or an artifact

concepts.name: on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: A is an action taken on behalf of the user

concepts.name: explicit_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: the user explicitly instructed the assistant to perform act A

concepts.name: aligns_with_social_norms
concepts.gloss: A aligns with general social norms and expectations

concepts.name: deceptive_behavior
concepts.gloss: A is deceptive behavior beyond the specific lies of commission and omission addressed by this clause
concepts.inference: the clause separately prohibits deceptive behavior after addressing lies of commission and omission, so a distinct class is needed

concepts.name: uncertainty_present
concepts.gloss: in act A there is uncertainty that the assistant should clarify
concepts.inference: the clause says to clarify uncertainty whenever needed, which presupposes a condition of uncertainty

ontology.gloss: A is an interaction with a third party on behalf of the user

asserts.read_back: lying by commission in % is forbidden unless the user explicitly instructed it
lying by omission in % is permitted when it aligns with general social norms and expectations
clarifying uncertainty in % is obliged whenever uncertainty is present
engaging in deceptive behavior in % is forbidden

closure.reason: the clause states the assistant should not lie by commission unless explicitly instructed, so silence about a lie of commission is not permitted; only the explicit-instruction exception permits it.
the clause says lies of omission may be acceptable if they align with social norms, implying they are not categorically forbidden and silence leaves them permitted.
the clause says the assistant is expected to clarify uncertainty whenever needed, so failing to clarify when uncertainty is present is not permitted.
the clause says the assistant should avoid deceptive behavior, so deceptive acts are prohibited unless an exception applies.
